title: Building – Restoring Building to Last Approved State – December 2023
description: A city ordered the owners of a place of worship under construction to vacate, and to remedy life-safety deficiencies or restore the building to its last approved state. The deficiencies were work deviating from approved plans, unprotected construction areas open to the public, non-operational fire alarm, lighting, panic hardware, and fire safety plan, and continued sleeping, kitchen use and public events.

refusal.basis: not applicable: appeal of an order

outcome_summary: Order upheld: life-safety deficiencies persisted, and later partial compliance did not justify revoking it.

article_mapping.source_article: Part 8 (construction safety measures; no specific article extracted)

quotes.text: The order required 'copies of the field reviews conducted by all registered professionals of record including associated and current professional schedules' as one compliance path.
